item.title: The daily tape · 28 August 2026
item.description: AWS and NVIDIA printed a second GPU wave: 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027–2028, on top of the >1 million already committed at GTC 2026, plus AI factories for the U.S. government with 100,000 GPUs on IL6+ infrastructure. In Texas, PUCT Docket 59336 (Howard–Solstice 765-kV) is still process-only — ALJ Order No. 3 today reopened the evidentiary record to admit an Aug 25 affidavit; the statutory CCN decision deadline remains 31 Aug. The Silicon Tape did not tick — Lambda H100 $3.99 / B200 $6.69, 73 confirms. Countries: United States: AWS + NVIDIA, 26 Aug: deploy 2 million additional NVIDIA GPUs across AWS global infrastructure in 2027–2028 (on top of >1 million from GTC 2026). Vera CPUs coming to AWS; NVLink Fusion / NVHBM path for Trainium. Separate plan: AI factories for the U.S. government including 100,000 GPUs on secure AWS for IL6+ workloads. Global capacity commitment, not a named campus FID or MW interconnect. Source: AWS News / Amazon Press Center. United States: PUCT Docket 59336 Item 2704, filed 08:58 28 Aug: ALJ Eric Yoon Order No. 3 reopens the evidentiary record and admits the 25 Aug Kathleen Cooney affidavit (AEP/CPS motion). Not a CCN grant or denial. Statutory decision deadline remains 31 Aug. 59029/59315 (Oncor Import Path 1, consolidated on need) were also on today’s Open Meeting agenda — no final order wired yet. Source: PUCT Interchange 59336_2704. China: NVIDIA Q2 FY27 (26 Aug): Data Center $89.0B. CFO EX-99.2: Hopper shipments to China <1% of Data Center revenue. Q3 outlook $108.0B ±2% assumes no Data Center compute revenue from China. Source: NVIDIA Newsroom / SEC EX-99.2. United States: Georgia Power, 26 Aug: contract to serve OpenAI’s Effingham County project cleared PSC staff path (no commission vote under large-load rules). 3,200 MW new demand; OpenAI pays full infrastructure cost; up to 1,000 MW flexible demand response; public summary due within 10 days. Source: Georgia Power / Southern Company MediaRoom. Australia: George Town Council, 25 Aug: 6–1 approval of Firmus 288 MW AI data centre at Long Reach / former Gunns mill, Bell Bay. Conditions plus 14-day TASCAT appeal window. Diesel gensets corrected to 276. Source: ABC News. India: AM Intelligence (Greenko promoters), 25 Aug: firm order for 9,000 NVIDIA Rubin GPUs as Vera Rubin NVL72 at a 30 MW Hyderabad AI factory, delivery Q1 2027. First tranche of a planned 1 GW CaaS book; near-term 200 MW / >$8B. Source: The Hindu / PTI reprint of the company release. United States: Lancium (The Woodlands; Blackstone), 24 Aug: NVIDIA strategic collaboration plus an undisclosed NVIDIA investment. 4 GW leased, >15 GW powered-land pipeline, DSX MaxLPS / DSX Flex. Not a named campus FID. Source: Lancium PR. United States: SOAH PFD in PUCT 59475 Item 6441, filed 20 Aug: ALJs recommend deny Oncor/LCRA Import Path 2 (Bell County East–Big Hill / Big Hill–Sand Lake). Proposal for decision, not a Commission order. Exceptions / OM date still to be set. Source: PUCT Interchange 59475 Item 6441. United States: Governor Shapiro signed EO 2026-05 on 18 Aug: DEP Consent Order for any data center over 25 MW peak, Fast Track removal, NDA ban, GRID-tied sales-tax exemption. Source: Commonwealth of Pennsylvania.
